community_tools.name: Superpowers (obra)
community_tools.description: 20+ battle-tested community skills covering TDD, debugging, and plan-to-execute workflows; 96k+ stars. Strong reference for skill design patterns and progressive disclosure conventions

community_tools.name: Awesome Claude Skills
community_tools.description: Largest curated skill catalog on GitHub; 22k+ stars. Useful for discovering community skill patterns, naming conventions, and real-world SKILL.md examples

community_tools.name: Skill Creator (Anthropic)
community_tools.description: Meta-skill for generating new SKILL.md files from natural language workflow descriptions; reference for bootstrapping skill authoring

community_tools.name: Matt Pocock Skills
community_tools.description: 23k+ stars. Curated set of practical engineering skills published straight from the author's .claude directory; high-signal reference for skill authoring style

community_tools.name: Superpowers Marketplace (obra)
community_tools.description: Official marketplace for the Superpowers ecosystem with 20+ battle-tested skills (/brainstorm, /write-plan, /execute-plan) and SessionStart context injection

community_tools.name: Everything Claude Code
community_tools.description: Hackathon-winning harness assembling 30 agents, 136 skills, 60 slash commands with 1282 tests at 98% coverage; reference for large-scale skill+agent packaging

community_tools.name: ComposioHQ Awesome Claude Skills
community_tools.description: 50+ production skills cross-compatible with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Gemini CLI; install via /skill add. Useful pattern reference for portable skill authoring

community_tools.name: Codex Skills Marketplace
community_tools.description: Codex skill marketplace; notable for Dimillian's macOS/iOS skills as cross-runtime skill design references

architecture_patterns.name: xAI x-algorithm
architecture_patterns.description: Open recommendation-system pipeline used as a pattern source for staged candidate generation, hydration, filtering, scoring, selection, validation, and side effects

research_and_methods.name: Microsoft SkillOpt
research_and_methods.description: MIT framework that optimizes skill documents as trainable artifacts via a rollout -> reflect -> validate loop with bounded add/delete/replace edits accepted only on a strictly non-regressing held-out score. Source for the Edit Gate (regression rule) in references/skill-validation.md; methodology only, not vendored as a skill
